blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government is eyeing the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to expand the overseas presence of locally produced coconuts, according to the Philippine Council for Agriculture and Fisheries (PCAF). In a statement, PCAF said its National Sectoral Committee on Coconut recently convened concerned government officials and private sector-partners to explore Middle East market opportunities for local coconut products through Project Coco Bridge.
